about_the_game:
The residents of Fortune's Hollow, once united around the magic that made the hamlet prosperous, are now beset by infighting and misfortune. For the treasure-hunting raccoon Finnegan, this is a chance to claim an unguarded bounty. But will his ambition survive his encounter with the desolate townsfolk and the noble minstrel intent on helping them?

Harmonicord is a non-linear 2D adventure full of puzzles, rope-swinging, and shenanigans. Explore the nooks and crannies of a quaint woodland while befriending forest creatures, playing songs, and solving conflicts.

Game Features

  • Discover shady glades, sunny fields, lofty treetops, and dim tunnels.

  • Work together with (and pick up and throw) the animal companions you gain to utilize unique abilities!

  • Sandbox-style puzzles encourage you to discover your own solutions using your environment and the critters that accompany you.

  • Sail past deadly obstacles in fluid rope-swinging action!

  • Learn to play songs that take on a magic of their own.

  • Collect objects beyond your reach using your trusty lasso!

  • Bright pixel art brings a cheerful air to Fortune's Hollow.

  • Happy, upbeat, and relaxing soundtrack!

short_description: How wonderful and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony! But that is not the case here. Explore a divided forest and solve conflicts between its animal residents. Combine their unique abilities and learn their Harmonies as you unlock the wood's secrets on a rope-slinging adventure!
